caption: The drawing features a single object: a ceramic cat figure sitting upright on a small, rounded base. The cat is painted in a mix of muted tones, predominantly tan, gray, and black, with darker patches distributed across its body, legs, and face. Its face has distinct, stylized black markings above the eyes and on the cheeks, yellow-tinted eyes, a small pink nose, red lips, and red-painted inner ears. Around its neck are small red spots suggesting a collar. The rounded base on which the cat is seated is painted a pale green with several white spots suggesting chipped or worn areas. The background is plain and uncolored, bordered by a thin, single-line frame.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Cat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
